modules.description: Vanlige symptomer og hvordan de beskrives på engelsk.
Kroppsdeler og ord du trenger når du spør hvor noe gjør vondt.
Utstyr, målinger og nyttige uttrykk i møte med pasienter og brukere.

words.definition: an unusually high body temperature
words.example: The patient has a fever.

questions.prompt: Hvilken setning høres mest naturlig ut?

words.definition: an action that forces air out of the lungs with a sudden sound
words.example: He has had a bad cough for three days.

words.definition: pain in the head
words.example: She has a headache and needs to rest.

words.definition: the feeling that you or the room are moving or spinning
words.example: Dizziness can make it difficult to stand.

words.definition: the feeling that you may vomit
words.example: The medication may cause nausea.

words.definition: the act of bringing food or liquid up from the stomach
words.example: The child has been vomiting since last night.

words.definition: an area becoming larger because of injury, inflammation or illness
words.example: There is swelling around the ankle.

questions.prompt: There is some _____ around the injured ankle.

words.definition: an area of irritated or inflamed skin
words.example: The patient has a red rash on both arms.

words.definition: an unpleasant physical feeling caused by injury or illness
words.example: Please tell me where you feel pain.

words.definition: pain or irritation in the throat, especially when swallowing
words.example: A sore throat can be a symptom of an infection.

words.definition: difficulty breathing or the feeling that you cannot get enough air
words.example: Call for help if the patient develops shortness of breath.

confusions.feedback: Use «breath» here. «Breathe» is the verb; «breath» is the noun.

words.definition: a strong feeling of physical or mental tiredness
words.example: Fatigue can continue after an illness.

words.definition: a feeling of cold with shaking, sometimes with fever
words.example: The patient has fever and chills.

words.definition: the loss of blood from the body
words.example: Apply pressure to stop the bleeding.

words.definition: a short loss of consciousness
words.example: Fainting can happen if a person is dehydrated.

words.definition: frequent loose or watery bowel movements
words.example: The patient has had diarrhoea since yesterday.

words.definition: difficulty emptying the bowels
words.example: Drinking enough water can help prevent constipation.

words.definition: an illness caused by harmful microorganisms entering the body
words.example: The wound shows signs of infection.

words.definition: the body's harmful response to a substance it is sensitive to
words.example: She developed an allergic reaction after taking the medicine.

words.definition: not awake and not aware of what is happening
words.example: The patient is unconscious but breathing.

words.definition: the upper part of the body containing the brain, eyes, ears, nose and mouth
words.example: He hit his head when he fell.

words.definition: the part of the body connecting the head to the shoulders
words.example: She has pain in her neck.

words.definition: the joint where the arm connects to the body
words.example: Can you move your shoulder?

words.definition: the front upper part of the body between the neck and abdomen
words.example: The patient reports pain in the chest.

words.definition: the rear part of the body from the neck to the pelvis
words.example: He has lower back pain.

words.definition: the organ that receives food, also commonly used for the front of the abdomen
words.example: My stomach hurts.

options: My abdomen is hurting me bodily.

words.definition: the area of the body between the chest and pelvis
words.example: The nurse examined the patient's abdomen.

words.definition: the upper limb from the shoulder to the hand
words.example: Raise your left arm, please.

words.definition: the joint in the middle of the arm
words.example: She has a small cut on her elbow.

words.definition: the joint connecting the hand and forearm
words.example: His wrist is swollen after the fall.

words.definition: the part at the end of the arm used for holding and touching
words.example: Wash your hands before and after patient contact.

words.definition: one of the five digits of the hand
words.example: He cut his finger while cooking.

words.definition: the joint connecting the leg to the pelvis
words.example: The patient has pain in her right hip.

words.definition: the joint between the upper and lower leg
words.example: Bend your knee slowly.

words.definition: the joint connecting the foot and lower leg
words.example: Her ankle is swollen.

words.definition: the part at the end of the leg used for standing and walking
words.example: Do you have any pain in your foot?

words.definition: the organs used for breathing
words.example: The lungs take oxygen into the body.

words.definition: the organ that pumps blood around the body
words.example: The heart pumps blood through the body.

words.definition: the passage inside the neck used for swallowing and breathing
words.example: Open your mouth so I can look at your throat.

words.definition: the outer covering of the body
words.example: Check the skin for redness or a rash.

words.definition: the pressure of blood against the walls of the blood vessels
words.example: I am going to check your blood pressure.

questions.prompt: I need to measure your blood _____.

words.definition: the regular beat that can be felt as the heart pumps blood
words.example: Your pulse is a little fast.

words.definition: a measurement of how hot or cold the body is
words.example: I am going to take your temperature.

words.definition: a strip or piece of material used to cover or support an injury
words.example: The nurse put a clean bandage on the wound.

words.definition: an injury in which the skin or other tissue is damaged
words.example: Keep the wound clean and dry.

words.definition: a medicine used to treat or prevent illness
words.example: Are you taking any medication?

words.definition: an arranged time to meet a healthcare professional
words.example: Your next appointment is on Monday.

words.definition: a chair with wheels used by a person who has difficulty walking
words.example: Would you like me to bring a wheelchair?

words.definition: supports used under the arms or hands to help a person walk
words.example: He is using crutches after his ankle injury.

words.definition: protective coverings worn on the hands
words.example: Put on clean gloves before dressing the wound.

words.definition: to clean the hands with soap and water
words.example: Please wash your hands before preparing food.

words.definition: a polite way to ask someone to sit down
words.example: Please take a seat while you wait.

words.definition: to take slow, deep breaths
words.example: Breathe deeply and try to relax.

confusions.feedback: Use «breathe» as the verb: «Breathe deeply». «Breath» is the noun.

words.definition: to explain what pain feels like and where it is
words.example: Can you describe your pain for me?

words.english: Are you allergic to any medication?
words.norwegian: Er du allergisk mot noen medisiner?
acceptedEnglish: Are you allergic to any medicine?
words.definition: a question used to check for medication allergies
words.example: Are you allergic to any medication?

words.definition: a simple patient-friendly question about the location of pain
words.example: Where does it hurt?

words.english: I am going to check your temperature.
acceptedEnglish: I'm going to check your temperature.
words.definition: a sentence used to explain a routine observation to a patient
words.example: I am going to check your temperature.

words.definition: a simple question offering assistance
words.example: Do you need help getting up?

words.english: Please tell me if this hurts.
words.norwegian: Si fra hvis dette gjør vondt.
words.definition: a sentence used while examining or helping a patient
words.example: Please tell me if this hurts.

words.definition: a reassuring sentence used to help someone feel secure
words.example: You are safe here. We are going to help you.
